Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring a public hospital district's proposed annexation to be published in a voters' pamphlet.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to publication of a public hospital district'sproposed annexation in a voters' pamphlet; and adding a new section tochapter 70.44 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 70.44 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A public hospital district shall, whenever the proposedannexation of territory to its jurisdiction is scheduled to appear ona special election ballot, print and distribute a local voters'pamphlet. However, a public hospital district may satisfy itsrequirements under this section to the extent it enters into interlocalagreements with all counties within which the public hospital districtand its proposed territorial additions are located for the publicationof the proposed annexation measure in the respective counties'pamphlets for special elections. (2) If a public hospital district's proposed annexation measure isscheduled to appear on a primary or general election ballot and anycounty within which the public hospital district is located has notadopted an ordinance authorizing the publication and distribution of a p. 1 SB 5419local voters' pamphlet, a public hospital district shall print anddistribute a local voters' pamphlet to voters within its jurisdictionand to voters in the territory proposed for annexation. If a publichospital district's proposed annexation measure is scheduled to appearon a primary or general election ballot but any local voters' pamphletpublished by any county within which the hospital district is locateddoes not publish the public hospital district's proposed annexationmeasure, a public hospital district shall print and distribute a localvoters' pamphlet to voters within its jurisdiction and to voters in theterritory proposed for annexation. (3) The format of all public hospital district's voters' pamphletsshall, whenever applicable, comply with the provisions of chapter29A.32 RCW regarding the publication of local voters' pamphlets.
